scripts.build: bun run build:core && bun run build:commonmark && bun run build:trap-extension && bun run build:traq
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint:check && bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run lint:rust && bun run verify
scripts.check:generated: bun run generate:bindings && bun run scripts/check-generated.ts
scripts.format: bun run format:prettier && bun run format:rust && bun run format:go
scripts.format:check: bun run format:prettier:check && bun run format:rust:check && bun run format:go:check
scripts.generate:bindings: bun run --cwd packages/commonmark generate:bindings && bun run --cwd packages/trap-extension generate:bindings && bun run --cwd packages/traq generate:bindings
scripts.format:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/core/Cargo.toml --all && cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/commonmark/Cargo.toml --all && cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/trap-extension/Cargo.toml --all && cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/traq/Cargo.toml --all
scripts.format:rust:check: cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/core/Cargo.toml --all --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/commonmark/Cargo.toml --all --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/trap-extension/Cargo.toml --all --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/traq/Cargo.toml --all --check
scripts.lint:rust: cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/core/Cargo.toml --locked --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/commonmark/Cargo.toml --locked --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/trap-extension/Cargo.toml --locked --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/traq/Cargo.toml --locked --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.test: bun run test:typescript && bun run test:rust && bun run test:go
scripts.test:go: go -C packages/core/go test ./... && go -C packages/commonmark/go test ./... && go -C packages/trap-extension/go test ./... && go -C packages/traq/go test ./...
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --manifest-path packages/core/Cargo.toml --locked --workspace --all-features && cargo test --manifest-path packages/commonmark/Cargo.toml --locked --workspace --all-features && cargo test --manifest-path packages/trap-extension/Cargo.toml --locked --workspace --all-features && cargo test --manifest-path packages/traq/Cargo.toml --locked --workspace --all-features
scripts.test:typescript: bun run --cwd packages/core test && bun run --cwd packages/traq test
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:core && bun run typecheck:commonmark && bun run typecheck:trap-extension && bun run typecheck:traq
scripts.verify: bun run check:architecture && bun run check:package && bun run check:generated
